title: SF-50s for DOGE staff who have departed the agency

communications.communication:
To Whom It May Concern:

Pursuant to the Freedom of Information Act, I hereby request the following records:

SF-50s or detailing agreements that record the arrival departure (and ideally any job transitions) for the following staff at GSA who were associated with DOGE activities and who have since left the agency:

* Edward Coristine
* Stephen Ehikian
* Luke Farritor
* Derek Geissler

* Alexander Simonpour
* Nicholas Gallagher
* Justin Fox
* Matthew Parkhurst
* Bridget Youngs
* Emily Bryant
* Alison Childs
* Bee Elvy
* Jack Stein
* Jonathan Mendelson
* Alexander Tullman
* Marshall Wood
* Raj Jegannathan
* Dave Malcher
* Ryan Shea
* Micaela Lopez Ballefin (may be employed as a consultant)
* Yat Choi
* Brian Burroughs
* Andrew Vilcsak
* Greg Barbaccia
* Joanna Wischer
* Jordan Wick
* Sully Vickers

All of these should be from January 20, 2025 or later. It's possible that some of these listed staff are not GSA employees but have been hired as consultants or have been detailed to the agency from other agencies. DOGE has often employed complicated staffing arrangements to avoid transparency expected from government agencies.

I also understand and expect that personal details like addresses or personal emails, etc. will be redacted from the FOIA release.

The requested documents will be made available to the general public, and this request is not being made for commercial purposes.

In the event that there are fees, I would be grateful if you would inform me of the total charges in advance of fulfilling my request. I would prefer the request filled electronically, by e-mail attachment if available or CD-ROM if not.

Thank you in advance for your anticipated cooperation in this matter. I look forward to receiving your response to this request within 20 business days, as the statute requires.

Sincerely,

Jacob Harris
